cells.quote: Participants in the VDT group demonstrated a larger increase in test scores from pre-test to post-test (M = − 8.70, p = 0.001) and from pre-test to follow-up (M = − 11.13, p = 0.001), with a substantial effect size (partial η² = 0.84). Additionally, the decline in scores from post-test to follow-up was less pronounced in the VDT group (M = − 2.43, p = 0.007) relative to the textbook group, indicating enhanced knowledge retention.
